codex.title: Use Codex with SmartGate
codex.subtitle: Connect Codex GUI to a SmartGate model service through the OpenAI Responses API. Keep Codex as your coding workspace while SmartGate provides routing, provider fallback, budgets, and usage tracking.
codex.step1_desc: Connect providers and choose the routing strategy for Codex requests.
codex.step2_desc: Authorize the model service so Codex can call it using its service name.
codex.step3_desc: Add the Profile and model catalog below, then restart Codex with the Profile.
codex.profile_desc: Save this as {path}. Replace the path, endpoint, model name, and API key with values from this workspace.
codex.why_chat_desc: Codex uses the OpenAI Responses API, while SmartGate translates the request for the configured upstream. For the Fusion Profile, use {code} when the upstream does not accept the Responses API {param} parameter.
codex.catalog_desc: Save this as {path}. The {code} must match the model service name authorized for the API key.
codex.start_desc: Use the standalone Profile so Codex does not try to load the model catalog from the base configuration.
codex.restart_hint: Restart Codex after changing the Profile or model catalog.
codex.err_401_desc: check the project API key and service grant.
codex.err_reasoning_desc: use objects with {effort} and {description}, not strings.
codex.security_warning: Keep {token} private. Do not commit the Profile file when it contains a real key; restrict local permissions and rotate the key if it is exposed.
